snippet.title: GAME TRAILER: Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter IV: Sacred Feathers
snippet.description:
Welcome back to to the courtroom in a world where all anime genres exist at once, as Lore meets Law for a thrilling clash between evil and sparkly, sparkly magical girls!

Play the 4th chapter in this follow-up to NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE, as Nina is drawn into a new murder case of truly magical proportions.

WISHLIST now over on Steam!
